AiP74LVC2GU04GC363.TR, a dual unbuffered inverter integrated circuit (IC)
• Operating Supply Voltage (\(V_{CC}\)): 1.65V to 5.5V (Supports mixed 3.3V and 5V system logic environments).
• Output Drive Capability (\(I_{OH}/I_{OL}\)): ±24 mA at 3.0V.
• Propagation Delay (\(t_{pd}\)): ~1.7 ns at 5.5V with a 50 pF load.
• Quiescent Current (\(I_{CC}\)): ≤ 4 μA.
• Operating Temperature Range: -40°C to +105°C.
• Output Type: Push-pull
